# Malformed fixtures

Inputs that are broken or at the limits, for upload validation and parser error
handling. Generated by `tooling/fixtures/make_fixtures.py`; do not edit by hand.

| File | What it is | Expected behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `empty.pdf` | A syntactically valid PDF whose page tree has 0 pages | Rejected as "no pages" (4xx at upload confirm or a non-retryable activity error); never a crash or an empty successful extraction |
| `not_a_pdf.pdf` | Plain text bytes with a `.pdf` name (no `%PDF-` header) | Rejected by content sniffing, not by extension; non-retryable error |
| `huge_page_count.pdf` | 200 near-empty letter pages, about 94 KB | Page-count limit enforced (rejected, or truncated by policy with a clear reason); must not exhaust memory or the LLM budget |
| `tiny.jpg` | 8 x 8 pixel JPEG | Rejected as too small to analyze, or analyzed as `ambiguous`; never upscaled into a confident result |
| `oversize.jpg` | 6000 x 4000 solid-color JPEG, about 367 KB | Downscaled to at most 1024 px on the long side before any model call (S3_SPEC section 4); the dimensions alone must not cause a failure |
